question: What is the minimal set of physical laws and initial conditions that necessarily gives rise to self-referential systems capable of asking this question?

responses_summary.grok: The question points to an open frontier rather than a settled derivation. No presently known minimal set is proven to *necessarily* produce self-referential systems; at best we have candidate ingredie
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: Recursive self-reference sustained against dissipation; any substrate permitting feedback gradients and bounded persistence suffices.
